lines.t: I’m sitting on the edge of a bed that isn't mine
Trying to find the thread, trying to find the line
The floorboards are cold and the windows are thin
I’m listening for the place where the silence begins
I’ve got a pocket full of stones and a heart full of glass
Just waiting for the winter and the shadows to pass.
And I can feel the pull, I can feel the weight
Of a thousand small choices at the narrow gate.
So let the night come, let the wind blow cold
I’m holding onto stories that the prophets told
It’s a quiet kind of war, it’s a long, dark climb
But I’m leaving all my ghosts in the middle of the time
Yeah, I’m leaning on the Word, I’m leaning on the Light
I’m gonna make it through the valley tonight.
I found a name in the margins of a dusty page
It felt like a key to a rusted-out cage
I’m breathing in the air of a different sky
Watching all the old versions of me start to die
It’s a beautiful wreck, it’s a holy mess
But I’m finding the peace in the middle of the test.
I was hiding...
In the hollow...
Now I’m moving...
Where You lead I’ll follow.
Yeah, the Stone! (The Stone!)
Is rolled away!
I’m walking out the grave today!
So let the night come, let the wind blow cold
I’m holding onto stories that the prophets told
It’s a quiet kind of war, it’s a long, dark climb
But I’m leaving all my ghosts in the middle of the time
Yeah, I’m leaning on the Word, I’m leaning on the Light
I’m gonna make it through the valley tonight.
Through the valley tonight...
Just a dusty book...
And a narrow road...
I’m almost home.
